title: Skyworth Coocaa K3 Pro 90P3D Max (8R145_P3DM, Realtek RTD2885N), China market
header: # Skyworth Coocaa K3 Pro 90P3D Max (system board 8R145_P3DM, Realtek RTD2885N), # Android 11 (SDK 30), build eng.www-da.20231205.132148, China-market Coocaa OS. # First China-market Coocaa (Realtek) list in this repo. The export Skyworth lists in # this folder (com.skyworth.* Google TV builds) share nothing with this firmware: here # the namespace is com.coocaa.* / com.tianci.* and the stock launcher is # com.tianci.movieplatform. # # Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/coocaa-k3-pro-90p3d-max/debloat.txt # Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/coocaa-k3-pro-90p3d-max/debloat.txt # Everything is DISABLED (pm disable-user --user 0), not uninstalled. Comment out any # line you want to keep. # # ⚠ CRITICAL: NEVER disable com.tianci.movieplatform (the Coocaa launcher). The 8R145 # boot flow hard-depends on it: disabling it hangs the TV on the COOCAA logo, the remote # becomes unresponsive, and the only recovery is a factory reset from recovery mode # (verified the hard way). It is deliberately absent from the list below. # # ADB: this firmware hides Developer options. ADB is toggled from the Coocaa factory # menu (a secret key sequence), not from stock Settings, and ro.adb.secure is set, so # the TV still shows the "Allow USB debugging?" prompt. The ADB toggle resets on every # reboot - re-enable it from the factory menu after rebooting. # # Launcher notes (for anyone porting cleanyourtv to this set): # 1. Almost no app declares a leanback entry on this firmware: the Home grid starts #    nearly empty (only the app store resolves LEANBACK_LAUNCHER).

Quirks: Git Bash rewrites /data/... paths for tools/tv.py --pull, so set # MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1; screencap to /sdcard fails here, use /data/local/tmp. Launcher installed with # tools/tv.py --push + pm install, later with build-and-install.sh (b64push md5 matched). Reboot-checked: all # packages stayed disabled, Home stayed on the new launcher, both key services re-bound. # # Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (disabled by build-and-install.sh). setupwraith claims # HOME (priority 1) once it is off, so it is in group 1b. Check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first: # on this unit the Wi-Fi network in use belonged to android.uid.system, so disabling setupwraith kept it. # # Remote (Bluetooth BT_RC813_M1, /dev/input/event3, /system/usr/keylayout/Generic.kl): # - Input (TV_INPUT) and the mic keep working without launcherx. # - Netflix (242, TCL_NETFLIX), YouTube (245, TCL_YOUTUBE)
